highlights: Introducing the Baseus Bipow 15W 30000mAh Digital Display  Power Bank with the product code PPDML-K01.

Stay Powered On the Go: If you’re constantly on the move and rely on various electronic devices, you understand the struggle when your device batteries run low, especially when you can’t connect them to a charging socket. In such situations, the Baseus power bank comes to your rescue. This high-capacity power bank features multiple USB ports, allowing you to connect up to four devices simultaneously.

Modern Design and Technology: Baseus offers a sleek and modern design with this power bank. The slim format takes up minimal space while delivering impressive performance. The rounded edges and digital display on the side add a touch of elegance to the gadget.

High Universality: This power bank is designed to meet the needs of users with multiple devices. With four USB ports – two standard, one micro, and one type C – you can simultaneously charge four different devices. Each port is specific to a device’s requirements, ensuring seamless and efficient charging.

Large Capacity: The Baseus power bank is renowned for its significant capacity of 30000mAh. This ample capacity allows you to charge multiple devices without the fear of running out of power while you’re on the go. The digital display keeps you informed about the battery level, so you’re always in control.
Type: Power bank with a digital display
